initial_diagnostic.scope: Initial reference/Rc/inline-hint candidate. All six CoreMark CRC validation checks passed; the driver then incorrectly required identical whole-process instruction totals (time formatting varies). These timings are diagnostic only; original metrics were not saved. Final driver saves incrementally and only requires exact counts for deterministic assembly.
